Aggregate.description:
One table row's difference over a window (`armo_table_entry`, kinds `ARMO_AGG_*`). `tid`
is 0 for a row a kernel map keeps per process.

oneOf.description:
armod's items of design 6.7 over `duration_s`, answered with a `selfcheck` reply.
`pids` is armo-collectd's selection; empty: every process.

Sends the records armod holds, then answers: every record from before the request
arrives ahead of the reply. Without `drain_only` the answer also waits until the
attaches asked for before are in; an ending recording needs only the records.

ArmodWindow.description: The kernel maps' differences over one window.

probe_changes.description: The attaches and detaches that ended since the last window. Proto 1.7.

usage.description: armod's own CPU over the window and its RSS (design 6.8). Proto 1.4.

Attach.description:
`node`, `topic` and `exclude` are regular expressions over whole names (design 14.3). In
`state`, `pids` also holds the processes they matched. Proto 1.5.

user_words.description: Thread id to the address of its slot's `cur_cb` (design 15.2), host ids.

BpfProg.description: Differences over the window. `pid` is null for a program shared by every process.

service.description: The service name of a service callback. Proto 1.5.

pss.description: Read each process's PSS: a walk of its page tables under its mmap_lock. Proto 1.7.

hists.description: By the name of the entity's latency field.

Hist.description: For `log2`, bucket `i` counts `[2^i, 2^(i+1))` ns over `armo_common::BUCKETS` buckets.

Interference.description:
Kernel counters over a recording, end minus start (design 14.9). Per CPU vectors are
indexed by CPU number.

interrupts.description: `/proc/interrupts` by row; the numbered (device) rows are summed into `dev`.

steal_ticks.description: Time a hypervisor ran something else, from `/proc/stat`.

Overflow.description: What the preload shim could not take, counted since it made its file.

ProbeChange.description:
One program attached to or detached from the points of one file (design 6.8): the
kernel patched code and flushed TLBs on the CPUs then, monotonic ns.

probe_changes.description: armod's attaches and detaches during the recording. Proto 1.7.

realtime_steps.description:
When CLOCK_REALTIME stepped during the recording, monotonic ns. Wall-clock ages and
timestamp pairings near these are not to be trusted. Proto 1.7.

system_start.description:
The host's settings that change what a measurement means, read at the start and at
the end; an unreadable one is left out (design 14.9). Proto 1.7.

RecordOptions.description: The options of design 14.3, one field each. An absent field takes the default there.

Reply.description: Told apart by their fields; the request's `id` says which op it answers.

Select.description:
`node`, `topic` and `exclude` are regular expressions over whole names (design 14.3). In
`state`, `pids` also holds the processes they matched. Proto 1.5.

Selection.description:
`node`, `topic` and `exclude` are regular expressions over whole names (design 14.3). In
`state`, `pids` also holds the processes they matched. Proto 1.5.

ThreadCounters.description:
A target thread's faults and scheduler statistics; from its start when it began during
the recording.

hists.description: Window records only (14.4): entity id, then latency field name.
